note: Towns decided by hand for boards that name no usable town. Read by scripts/board-sweep.mjs (placeFromPlaces) BEFORE the directory. A board is matched on its operator name exactly as the board's own title spells it, plus its locationId; a board with one location and no id matches on the operator alone. Each entry names its evidence. Where the operator has several yards and the board does not say which, the entry says so and the town is the operator's headquarters. Scranton Equity Exchange is absent too: its canola is quoted in USD per cwt against a per-tonne futures quote, the guard refuses the whole board on it, and a manifest would publish nothing. Boards that are price sheets for several plants (Glacial Lakes Energy, Michael Foods, Pomeroy Grain, Northwest Grain Growers) are deliberately absent: one town would be wrong for them. Canadian boards (Sunderland, Sharpe) are absent: they are quoted in tonnes and need the CA manifest fields first.
